verdict.rationale: Galileo's release notes document queues that organize sessions, traces, and spans for structured review by subject matter experts, which directly covers routing outputs to human review queues. The marketing site separately says SME annotations can be captured into datasets, though thinly. missing for 10: dedicated in-depth docs on queue setup and labeling/annotation schemas, evidence of programmatic (SDK/API) or rule-based routing into queues, independent or hands-on corroboration.
